'''Otua Blank's stronghold''' was a location on the [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]] and the home to the tyrannical dictator of the planet, [[Otua Blank/Legends|Otua Blank]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], after a [[Safe cargo objective/Legends|long battle]] on a [[Subtram/Legends|subtram]], the final stop was on this fortress, where former [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] brought the "cargo" to Otua Blank and leaving, only to allow the tyrannical dictator to open it and find out that the cargo did not contain a [[Pluma Sodi/Legends|young Kage girl]], but a gagged, handcuffed, and infuriated [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].
